name: smwsprites-new-super-mario-bros-spiked-question-mark-block
title: New Super Mario Bros - Spiked Question Mark Block
description:
This is a spiked question mark block, a block which rotates itself while one side is spiked. It's non-dynamic so it can only turn in four directions but it is easier to insert and more than four can be on-screen as well. The content can be filled in various ways.

Credits is required.

Requested by Ice Man.
